author: Glitchaye
body:
Ayy guys. I made a version 2 of Ascension. But be warned, you'll need a somewhat powerful pc to run the texture pack... As the swords are 512x512

Download : http://www.mediafire.com/download/6s2stdy7aow8t3r/Ascension+V2.zip


Imgur Album : http://imgur.com/a/favDW


Enjoy!
EDIT : Have Item animations on, as most items are animated in some way.
